name: nansen-mcp
description: MCP server for Nansen smart-money holdings + token anomaly tools, scoped to Mantle. Required by agents/smart-money-mirror-manager.md. When NANSEN_API_KEY is unset the server returns a degraded `nansen_mode:"envio_only"` payload sourced from the IndexFlow Envio HyperIndex (Mantle DEX swap events), so the smart-money-mirror agent can still run with reduced confidence weights.
